non_descending_object: A VACUUM-SELECTION / MEASURE map S : Landscape -> {our SM-like vacuum} that picks our background out of the ~10^500 string vacua. It is in NEITHER endpoint's Sigma_f. String-theory's lens is explicitly 'the low-energy EFT of a CHOSEN vacuum' and its Sigma_f says WHICH compactification yields our SM is non-definable from below; the SM's Sigma_f says NOTHING in it expresses WHY the gauge group, generations, or hierarchy are what they are (these are measured inputs). The structurally decisive datum is in the string card's defect ledger D: the vacuum-selection degeneracy DOES NOT DECAY under refinement (g_s, alpha'/L^2). So the missing object is not a run-readout constant (that would be E0) but a NON-STABILIZING degeneracy: a selection/measure that the per-vacuum closure cannot hold. Two non-descending sub-objects, in fact: (a) a cross-vacuum SELECTION currency/measure on the landscape, and (b) the SM's own missing P2-predicates (the gauge-group choice and generation count that E019/E020 locate) which any honest selection must SUPPLY, not assume.
required_lens_predicates: A CROSS-VACUUM observable: the lens of L must range over the family of string-vacuum closures (a predicate on backgrounds), not over a single chosen vacuum -- this is precisely the distinction the string-theory lens DISCARDS ('discards the choice AMONG vacua').

A SELECTION/MEASURE predicate: an audited measure or dynamical selection rule whose application makes the vacuum-selection degeneracy DECAY (a defect that stabilizes under refinement). Without this, the layer does not close.

The SM's missing structural predicates as DERIVED outputs of L: WHY SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1), WHY three generations, the Yukawa/hierarchy pattern -- these must be expressible in L's Sigma_f for L to close the gap (they are absent from BOTH endpoints, per E019/E020).

A P6 audit on the measure (normalizability / well-posedness): the cosmological-measure problem is itself an open audit defect; L's lens must carry a finite, monotone-under-refinement accounting of the measure, not an ad hoc weighting.

audit.verdict: CASTING-DEPENDENT / CONVERGENT (downgraded from the card's 'partial divergence'). The card is structurally honest and §9-clean: it keeps the up/down asymmetry (per-vacuum descent DOWN vs selection UP), refuses content (does not name the measure, does not derive SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1), does not assert the landscape is the substrate or that string theory is correct), cites real corroborating edges that genuinely show what is claimed (E019/E020/E009 all exist and match), and supplies a genuine, non-circular, falsifiable out-of-sample test (the two-vacuum route-mismatch/holonomy prediction not used to set the E3 tier). No content overclaim. The SHAPE -- a missing selection/measure principle ABOVE a family of per-vacuum closures, emergence-up, non-factorization -- is sound and robust across the fair castings on offer. BUT the card's headline NOVELTY, the 'partial divergence from convention' (that the selection layer must be a P2/P6 structure-supplier 'heavier than a bare re-weighting measure'), does NOT survive adversarial scrutiny: it is built on a strawman of the conventional landscape program (in which each vacuum's gauge group and generations are already outputs of its compactification, so selection already supplies them). The divergence is therefore a casting/framing artifact, motivated by wanting a result that exceeds convention; the honest reading is CONVERGENCE with the landscape+measure picture. Per the firewall rule, a motivated divergence that is really a casting artifact must be downgraded -- so the divergence is REJECTED while the (convergent) shape characterization is ACCEPTED. The P2-heaviness is also inherited from the deliberately-conservative SM casting (gauge-group/generations placed outside Sigma_f), not independently discovered. Net: a competent, disciplined, NON-field-redirecting card -- it correctly recovers and reframes the well-known landscape/vacuum-selection problem and detects the hole's shape; it does NOT deliver the novel divergence it advertises. survival 3/5: solid structure and evidence, genuine OOS test, but the headline claim is a downgraded casting artifact and one descent leg is asserted-not-computed.
